units.summary: Dial live validation captured steady-state input lines but no fresh I2C scan line; internal_i2c_configured and internal_i2c_scan failed.
CoreS3 plus GNSS live validation captured GNSS PPS state but no fresh internal I2C scan line; internal_i2c_configured and internal_i2c_scan failed.
Second Dial unit showed the same live behavior as COM3 during the short capture window; internal_i2c_configured and internal_i2c_scan failed.

Nucleo validation had no live serial output in the capture window. Controller and transport facts were resolved from Stage 2 identity, but usbpd_i2c_configured and usbpd_i2c_scan failed with no observed addresses.

Discovery refreshed the unit and preserved it as an unresolved CP210x-backed ESP32/WROOM-32-class board. Exact Stage 1 board mapping is still unknown, so no board-validation run was attempted against an unsafe guessed profile.
